description:
Activate Sarcatog's second abilty by sacrificing Mox Opal.
Yomiji triggers, returning Mox Opal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Cast Mox Opal by paying {0}.
Repeat.
If you control at least one additional artifact, you may also activate Mox Opal once per loop, resulting in infinite colored mana.
